questions.prompt: How many children aged 5 to 17 worldwide were engaged in child labour in 2024, according to ILO and UNICEF estimates?
questions.insight: Child labour has fallen by over 20 million children since 2020, reversing an increase between 2016 and 2020.

questions.prompt: According to the IEA, what share of global electricity consumption was used by data centres in 2024?
questions.insight: Data-centre electricity use has grown by about 12% a year over the past five years.

questions.prompt: According to the WHO/World Bank 2025 UHC Global Monitoring Report, how many people worldwide still lacked coverage for essential health services as of 2023?
questions.insight: In 2022, 2.1 billion people also experienced financial hardship from out-of-pocket health spending.

questions.prompt: On average since about 1900, how many earthquakes of magnitude 7.0 or greater occur worldwide in a typical year?
questions.insight: USGS expects about 16 major earthquakes a year, including 15 in the magnitude 7 range and one of magnitude 8.0 or greater.

questions.prompt: In 1870, on average, how many hours per year did a full-time non-agricultural production worker in Germany work, by historians' estimates?

source.name: Huberman & Minns (via Our World in Data)

questions.insight: Working time has fallen sharply since: the average German worker put in about 1,335 hours in 2023, though that figure covers all workers, part-timers included.
